digest.component_or_area: gate_dispatch and container_stage LLM error handling
propositions: Three defensive exception arms in gate_dispatch and container_stage that decide LLM-tier failure behavior (abort vs. degrade) have no test coverage reaching them despite being mutation-proven active.
Plan-review mid-run arm in gate_dispatch is reachable in production via batch-runner path when container warm-call raises LLMUnavailableError or LLMInputRejectedError through pass1.
Code-review mid-run arm in gate_dispatch is a defensive seam contract at run_workflow boundary; no in-tree production raiser found but warrants test-as-contract pinning.
Container stage warm-call abort raises both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError to short-circuit fan-out, but this path is untested in real _run_container execution.
New test suite must verify degraded INDETERMINATE verdicts with gate_error sidecar emission for both exception types, plus seam-fidelity validation that batch-runner exceptions propagate raw.
